all_required_checks.known_f1_tolerance: mean AdaSCALE minus SCALE Known F1 >= -0.005 and worst >= -0.02
all_required_checks.metric_breadth: positive mean oriented gain over SCALE on at least 2 of 4 metrics
all_required_checks.split_integrity: AdaSCALE, source MLP and OpenDetect fingerprints identical
all_required_checks.suite_robustness: at least 4 of 7 suites nonnegative and worst suite >= -0.05
all_required_checks.top_two_rank: AdaSCALE four-unknown-metric mean rank among four methods <= 2.0

failure_action: retain the 14-scenario pilot and do not spend full-matrix budget
full_matrix_action: run all 102 frozen seed7 scenarios only if every check passes
oriented_metric_rule: higher is better except lower unknown_fpr95 is better
